title: A Winter for the Cellar
author: Ansel Iversen
blurb: Ulyana Sterling, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
